PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return (C-section) Home Program"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "gradual postpartum recovery, core reconnection, full-body strength"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Weeks 1-4 (Light activity only; no abs/heavy lifting)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Gentle Mobility + Walking":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x6..8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x6..8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          cat_cow 2x6..8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Mobility + Gentle Lower Body":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x6..8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x6..8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x6..8 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 2x6..8 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          calf_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Upper Body Mobility + Posture":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x6..8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          scapular_retraction 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          arm_circles 2x10..12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          chest_stretch 2x20..30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 28m "Walking + Core Connection":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          cat_cow 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x25..35 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 28m "Lower Body Control":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x8 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          calf_stretch 2x25..35 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 28m "Upper Body Mobility + Back":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 3x10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 2x8..10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          arm_circles 2x12..15 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          chest_stretch 2x25..35 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Walking + Mobility Flow":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x8..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x8..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          cat_cow 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          hip_circles 2x8..10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x30..40 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Glutes + Legs Gentle":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 2x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          calf_stretch 2x30..40 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Posture + Shoulders":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x8..10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 2x8..10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          chest_stretch 2x30..40 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 32m "Walk + Gentle Total Body":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x30..45 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 32m "Mobility + Control":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          scapular_retraction 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          calf_stretch 2x30..45 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
      DAY Friday training 32m "Preparation for Next Phase":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x30..45 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
  PHASE "Phase 2: Weeks 5-8 (After 6-week check, gradual loading without heavy lifting)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Core Reintro + Lower":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x6..8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x30..40
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Upper + Posture":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6..8 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 2x10..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2x30..40
      DAY Friday training 35m "Core + Glutes":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          split_squat 3x6..8 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12..15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2x30..40
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 38m "Lower Emphasis":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x30..45
      DAY Wednesday training 38m "Upper Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x10..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x10..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2x30..45
      DAY Friday training 38m "Core + Balance":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12..15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2x30..45
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Lower Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          goblet_squat 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x35..45
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2x35..45
      DAY Friday training 40m "Core + Single-Leg":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          split_squat 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2x35..45
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Lower Progression":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          goblet_squat 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x40..50
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper Progression":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2x40..50
      DAY Friday training 40m "Core + Glutes Progression":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          split_squat 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2x40..50
  PHASE "Phase 3: Weeks 9-12 (Build capacity and strength; introduce variety)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 42m "Lower + Core":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          goblet_squat 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x45..55
      DAY Wednesday training 42m "Upper Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2x45..55
      DAY Friday training 42m "Core + Single-Leg":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          split_squat 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2x45..55
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          goblet_squat 5x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x50..60
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 5x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 5x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2x50..60
      DAY Friday training 45m "Core + Conditioning Walk":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 4x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          split_squat 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Volume":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          goblet_squat 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x50..60
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Volume":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2x50..60
      DAY Friday training 45m "Core + Single-Leg Volume":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          split_squat 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2x50..60
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Capstone":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          goblet_squat 5x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 5x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 4x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x50..60
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Capstone":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 5x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 5x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 4x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2x50..60
      DAY Friday training 45m "Core + Conditioning Walk Capstone":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 4x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          split_squat 5x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 5x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
